card.title: Useful Enough to Stay
card.instruction: Make yourself constantly useful and read each response as evidence of whether you still belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've organised the pens. You'll still need me tomorrow, won't you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Go home; I'm just finishing the rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can finish it. Put me wherever there's a gap.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've given you Saturday off. You're part of the team, not emergency cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll train the emergency cover on Friday so you won't regret Saturday.
